study type: Case-control study nested within a longitudinal cohort
exposure: Placental gene expression (glucocorticoid receptor b, serotonin transporter, connexin 43, zonula occludens-1, serotonin receptor 2B)
Pregnancy-specific anxiety during the second trimester
cohort: A subsample of 28 children with febrile seizures and 84 matched controls, drawn from a longitudinal 3D pregnancy cohort of 2366 mother-child dyads.
finding: Placental normalized gene expression was statistically different between children with FS and controls, with specific genes related to glucocorticoid, serotonergic, and fetal/placental growth systems showing altered expression, suggesting these are candidate mechanisms for increased offspring vulnerability to FS.
